Informatieavond profielkeuze op dinsdag: Profile choice information evening on Tuesday 3 November
In klas 3 kies je een profiel: de vakken: In year 3 you choose a profile: the subjects you take your exams in. On this evening you and your parents hear how that works and what you can do with each profile.
[FOTO: derdeklassers en ouders bij de pr: [PHOTO: year 3 pupils and parents at the profile market in the auditorium]
Leerlingen van 3 havo en 3 vwo en hun ou: Pupils of 3 havo and 3 vwo and their parents
De decaan legt uit wat een profiel is en: The careers adviser explains what a profile is and when you choose. Then you walk past the four profiles. Teachers and pupils from years 4 and 5 tell you what you learn there and what you can do afterwards.
Talen, geschiedenis, kunst en maatschapp: Languages, history, art and social studies
Biologie, scheikunde en wiskunde A of B: Biology, chemistry and mathematics A or B
Je kiest niet op deze avond. In december: You do not choose on this evening. In December and January you talk with your mentor and the careers adviser. You pass on your provisional choice in February. A question? Email the careers adviser, Marloes Peters, via
Meld je aan met je ouders, dan weten wij: Register with your parents, so we know how many chairs are needed.
